section.div: Nginx Block Bad Bots, Spam Referrer Blocker, Vulnerability Scanners, User-Agents, Malware, Adware, Ransomware, Malicious Sites, with anti-DDOS, Wordpress Theme Detector Blocking and Fail2Ban Jail for Repeat Offenders

Self-hosted runtime control plane for AI agents. Observe or HITL approve or Block rogue tool calls before it executes: secret leaks, prompt injection, supply chain etc in a local dashboard. Agent agnostic (Claude,codex etc.)
Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
Monoscope lets you ingest and explore your logs, traces and metrics. We store these in S3 compatible buckets. Query in natural language via LLMs.
